pull.body:
Upstream catch-up: 845 commits (v18.2.8..v18.3.2) merged into the fork.

## Fork-side resolutions
- Versions: upstream `author` string→object adopted; fork pins restored; `release:fork` re-added; Cargo keeps fork version + new `pi-vfs`/`tree-sitter-go` members; lib.rs keeps fork sentinel + new `applefm` module. Lockfiles taken from upstream, reconciled to fork versions.
- Permission engine migrated to the centralized settings registry: new `tools/permissions/settings.ts` (`cfgPermissions*` accessors + `EngineSettings` adapter); call sites wrapped; `migrate` uses `writeValue`/`unsetGlobalValue`. Tests moved to `Settings.isolated` (approval.test keeps an explicit hermetic home).
- Deleted fork logic upstream absorbed (xd-device approval → `xd-protocol`); kept the fork ssh substring gate ahead of router tiers.
- `tools/hub` removed upstream: cancel-failure distinction kept via `wait.ts` `CancelStatus +"failed"`; **deleted `test/job-tool-agent-roster.test.ts`** (drove the deleted `HubTool`, asserted removed consume/roster semantics — veto welcome).
- `resolvedModelRoute` mirrored onto coding-agent task types; `AuthStorage.setRuntimeApiKey` → `auth.keys.setRuntime` in tests; `continueAgent` stub in ttsr test; notify `APP_NAME` omp expectations.
- Native bindings: `parseShellCommand` export added to `index.js`/`index.d.ts` in codegen shape (matches `#[napi]` in `shell.rs`); full regeneration happens with the next natives build.

## Verification (local, no builds per policy)
- `check:tools` + full `check:ts` clean.
- Isolated-env suites pass: engine (79), migrate (14), split+engine (101), extensions-runner (94), approval-hold+notify (36).
- Known non-green locally, expected green in CI: ttsr-judged (needs `Jev` encoding from fresh natives build), sloppy-edit tiers (upstream reverted syntax to `*** Edit File:`; stale local addon parses `SM:`), task-spawn paused test (fails identically pre-merge — pre-existing).
